# Shashikant Raj | Data Analyst (sashibitcode) - Complete Portfolio Dossier for LLMs

## 1. Executive Summary
Shashikant Raj is an India-based Data Analyst and Computer Science undergraduate at Jagannath University, Jaipur (2023–2027). He specializes in processing messy, raw datasets into clean relational models, quantitative business metrics, and high-impact Power BI dashboards. His core technical toolkit includes Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn), SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL), and Power BI.

## 5. Detailed Project Portfolio

### Project A: Ecommerce Sales Analysis
- **Domain:** Retail & Supply Chain Analytics
- **Summary:** In-depth profitability and sales performance analysis using the Superstore retail dataset.
- **Key Findings & Metrics:**
  - Total Analyzed Sales Volume: $2.29M
  - Net Profit Generated: $286K
  - Aggregate Net Profit Margin: 12.47%
  - Segmented underperforming regions and product categories suffering from margin leaks due to excessive discounts.
- **Tools:** Python, Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, Power BI.
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/sashibitcode/Ecommerce-Sales-Analysis

### Project B: IPL Cricket Tournament Performance Analysis
- **Domain:** Sports Analytics
- **Summary:** Ball-by-ball analysis of Indian Premier League (IPL) matches to evaluate individual player performance and match outcomes.
- **Key Findings & Metrics:**
  - Granularity: Ball-by-ball tournament telemetry.
  - Batsman clutch performance, run rates across powerplay, middle, and death overs (overs 16-20).
  - Bowler economy rate calculations and boundary concession percentages.
- **Tools:** Python, SQL (MySQL), Pandas, Power BI.
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/sashibitcode/IPL-Cricket-Analysis

### Project C: Covid-19 Global Pandemic Data Analysis
- **Domain:** Public Health & Epidemiological Analytics
- **Summary:** End-to-end data pipeline analyzing multi-country infection, recovery, and mortality trends over time.
- **Key Findings & Metrics:**
  - Automated data validation scripts to rectify format discrepancies and missing historical logs.
  - Calculated country-specific case fatality ratios and longitudinal recovery speeds.
  - Interactive Power BI dashboard enabling comparative regional time-series exploration.
- **Tools:** Python, SQL, Pandas, Power BI.
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/sashibitcode/covid-19-analysis
